title.en: The Crisis Crosses the Market Boundary

desc.zh: 粮价上涨越过市场边界：蜀地核对真实压力，向南国求购余粮，检疫、运输与账册决定救济能否公平到达，并为下一次短缺立下章程。
desc.en: Rising grain prices cross the market boundary: Shu audits real pressure and buys surplus grain from NQG, while quarantine, transport and ledgers decide whether relief arrives fairly — then charters rules for the next shortage.

title.en: Grain Prices Bring the News First

desc.zh: 蜀地市面上的粮价先于文书上涨。核对本地仓廪与市场行情之后，是否向确有余粮的邻国提出购买与运输安排，须由本地官署决定。
desc.en: Grain prices in Shu's markets rise before the reports do. After auditing local granaries and market prices, the offices must decide whether to approach a genuinely surplus neighbor about purchase and transport.

title.en: The Quarantine Dispute at the Docks

desc.zh: 粮道开到码头或山口，检疫与查验由谁执掌起了争议：有海路的走码头查验，内陆的走山口押运。朝鲜若以卫生规程闻名，其章程可被引用；吐蕃的山口商路亦可借道。关闭粮道同样是一种选择。
desc.en: The grain route reaches docks or mountain passes and inspection authority is contested: coastal routes face dock inspection, inland routes rely on escorted passes. If Korea is known for health regulation its standard may be adopted; TIB's passes can carry the convoy. Closing the corridor is also an option.

desc.zh: 无论这一季结果如何，蜀地都要决定是否为下一次短缺立下章程：常平仓章程、对账衙署，或只留下拒绝的记录。外方账目缺失时，本地记录也可结案。
desc.en: Whatever this season's result, Shu must decide whether to charter standing granary rules, fund an audit office, or only record the refusal. If the partner's ledgers are missing, the local record can close the case.

events.immediate: { if = { limit = { ywc_t08_shu_delivery_1357 = yes } remove_variable = ywc_t08_pending if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t08_popup_epoch } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch add = 1 } save_scope_value_as = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch value = var:ywc_t08_popup_epoch } ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes } }

label.zh: 支付 500 立常平仓章程

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t08_shu_at_1357 = yes var:ywc_t08_proposed_outcome ?= 1 gold_reserves >= 500 } add_treasury = -500 set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_granary_charter value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_outcome value = 1 } change_relations = { country = c:NQG value = 5 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:NQG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_partner_standing value = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 接受结局在案；南国对蜀关系增加 5。
consequence_note.en: The acceptance stands; NQG gains 5 relations with Shu.

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t08_shu_at_1357 = yes var:ywc_t08_proposed_outcome ?= 1 NOT = { gold_reserves >= 500 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_outcome value = 1 } change_variable = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch add = 1 } c:NQG = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_partner_standing value = 1 } } } }

consequence_note.zh: 接受结局在案，但无常平仓章程。
consequence_note.en: The acceptance stands, but without granary rules.

consequence_note.zh: 有限结局在案，但不设对账衙署。

label.zh: 外方账目缺失，按本地记录结案
label.en: Close by local record when the partner's ledgers are missing

options.effect: { if = { limit = { ywc_t08_shu_at_1357 = yes NOT = { has_variable = ywc_t08_proposed_outcome } } if = { limit = { OR = { var:ywc_t08_relief_mode ?= 1 var:ywc_t08_relief_mode ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_outcome value = 2 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_t08_outcome value = 4 } } change_variable = { name = ywc_t08_popup_epoch add = 1 } } }

consequence_note.zh: 已发过救济则按有限结局收束，否则按过期收束。
consequence_note.en: Delivered relief closes as limited; otherwise the arc lapses.
